name: COCA-COLA CONSOLIDATED, INC.
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-18, accession 0001628280-26-009057), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: no share-based/stock compensation adjustment appears among the operating-activity reconciling items for FY2025, FY2024 or FY2023, and the Consolidated Statements of Changes in Stockholders' Equity show no stock-compensation credit to additional paid-in capital in FY2023-FY2025 (APIC flat at $23,764 thousand through FY2024-FY2025). EDGAR companyfacts' last filed ShareBasedCompensation values are $0 for FY2020 and FY2021 (10-Ks filed 2021-02-26 / 2022-02-22).
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under the engine's tags. COKE has no equity-settled SBC to subtract: its only equity-linked plan, the Long-Term Performance Equity Plan for the CEO, is liability-accrued and may be cash-settled at the holder's election — its compensation expense ($10.7M FY2025, $10.5M FY2024, $10.3M FY2023, Note 2 of the FY2025 10-K) was never tagged ShareBasedCompensation (filed SBC was $0 in FY2020/FY2021 while LTPEP expense was $9.2M/$9.8M), the cost already sits inside net income/OCF, and the cash-flow statement adds nothing back, so subtracting it again as SBC would double-count it (same treatment as SQM/TS in this sweep). The filing-sourced equity SBC figure for the gap years is $0, which is also the engine's last filed value, so the override is in-band by construction.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-18, accession 0001628280-26-009057), Consolidated Statements of Operations: 'Weighted average number of Common Stock shares outstanding - assuming dilution' 83,807 thousand for FY2025 (90,524 thousand FY2024, 93,923 thousand FY2023), all retroactively adjusted for the 10-for-1 forward stock split effected May 27, 2025. Under the two-class method this Common diluted line is the company-wide diluted denominator: it equals Common basic 73,658 thousand + Class B diluted 10,149 thousand, and FY2025 net income $570,582 thousand / 83,807 thousand shares = the reported diluted EPS of $6.81 — the Class B diluted line is a component of the Common diluted line, not additive to it.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — diluted WASO is filed only by share class under the two-class method (class-dimensioned facts), so no undimensioned WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding fact survives into EDGAR companyfacts after FY2019 (last filed total: 9,417,000 pre-split shares, FY2019). The FY2025 company-wide diluted total from the 10-K fills the missing periods; the engine applies this single value to every unfiled year, so FY2024/FY2023 OE/share is overstated by ~8%/~12% versus their own filed totals (90,524,000 / 93,923,000) — documented in analysis.md. The count has since fallen further: the Nov 7, 2025 repurchase of The Coca-Cola Company's 18,835,460 shares took H1 2026 diluted WASO to 66,649 thousand (Q2 2026 10-Q), a step the FY2025-denominator bases do not capture — also documented in analysis.md.
